verdict.rationale: FFmpeg's own docs say streamcopy can modify container-level metadata, and cropping metadata is now supported for Matroska and MP4, so there is first-party metadata handling. But no evidence shows metadata is preserved by default across conversions or that an explicit strip option exists. One hands-on report says ffmpeg lost color information carried in QuickTime headers, which undercuts the preservation half of the story. Missing for 10: documented default metadata carry-over during transcoding, a documented option to strip metadata, reliable preservation of color/ICC header metadata, independent corroboration of fidelity.

support.subject: As a developer, file metadata is preserved through a conversion or strippable on request

citations.quote: Streamcopy is useful for changing the elementary stream count, container format, or modifying container-level metadata.
Cropping metadata is now supported with Matroska and MP4 formats.
